title: Event color palette
description: As a user I want to choose a color for my events
acceptance_criteria: Earlier fixed palette superseded by PBI-021 and updated THM-09; history remains in Sprint 003

title: Shared UI for existing screens
description: As a user I want existing calendar and dialog controls to work consistently across screen widths
acceptance_criteria: Existing calendar and dialog portions of UIC-14 to UIC-17 and UIC-27 to UIC-37; keyboard resize; accessible names; narrow layouts; Cancel/Save and confirmation

title: Calendar event drag
description: As a user I want to move events by dragging

title: Event dialog
description: As a user I want to open an event and add edit and remove my own events in a dialog
acceptance_criteria: EVT-01 to EVT-03 and EVT-07 and their sub-rows pass; clicking an event opens its details

title: Local event store
description: As a user I want my events kept on my device
acceptance_criteria: Events persist across restarts in UTC with their zones (TIM-01); a removed custom event can be undone (CAP-02)

title: Location address autocomplete
description: As a user I want addresses suggested while I type a location
acceptance_criteria: EVT-03.n passes; suggestions come from Photon (Product Owner decision 2026-11-22; hosting public or self-hosted still to decide); the map button keeps opening Google Maps (EVT-03.a)

title: Readable different-end-time-zone label
description: As a user, I want the different-end-time-zone option to stay readable in a narrow dialog
acceptance_criteria: EVT-01.j: show the full label at 12 px when it fits; otherwise show a localized short label (for example, Different end TZ) at 12 px before ellipsis; keep paired time fields aligned.

title: Non-color theme components
description: As a user I want consistent icons control sizes visual states and spacing
acceptance_criteria: Active non-color rows in THM-03 through THM-08 on existing UI; verify representative components and reduced motion

title: Shared UI for future screens
description: As a user I want the same shared controls in added screens
acceptance_criteria: Remaining UIC-14 to UIC-17 and UIC-27 to UIC-37 from PBI-010 as dependent features land

title: Expanded calendar print options
description: As a user I want to print calendar periods and options beyond the current view
acceptance_criteria: Remaining CAL-05 and PRT-01/02 calendar rows after PBI-022

title: Restore and verify the VS Code preview
description: The Product Owner could not verify Sprint 005 in the VS Code integrated browser because the preview stayed blank after restart
acceptance_criteria: Open SuiteStream at 127.0.0.1:8080 in the shared VS Code browser; confirm the calendar renders and verify the #93B4FF seeded theme and reminder resize with the Product Owner; record any startup errors
